data.description: As a standard action once every minute, an iathavos can fire beams of entropic energy from its 10 eyes.  Each of these beams of energy can be directed at a single target within 300 feet of the iathavos, but no more than one beam may be directed at any one creature.  Beams that are not directed at a creature are wasted.  The qlippoth must make a +15 ranged touch attack to hit with each beam.  Each beam has the same effect as a CL 20th disintegrate (40d6 damage, DC %1 Fortitude partial for 5d6 damage), except a creature killed by this damage explodes in a 5-foot burst of energy, flesh, shadow, and smoke instead of turning into dust.  Any creature in this burst must make a DC %1 Will save or be staggered for 1 round.
data.name: Entropic Beams
